identity_design_decision: Do not equate human venue labels with canonical meeting_id. Preserve venue/date/event as expected identity attributes and derive/freeze exact meeting_id only from the official race-level PRE source when available before race start.
validator_required_change: Replace the provisional meeting_id-in-{静岡,富山,松山} assumption with an explicit frozen assignment identity map containing expected venue/date/event plus official meeting_id learned from PRE-only official source. Until that map is frozen, validator must fail closed rather than invent an identifier.
source_hash_design: The canonical lock must hash exact bytes/content used for PRE extraction. A syntactically valid source_sha256 is insufficient; acquisition wrapper must compute SHA-256 itself and pass the computed digest with extracted PRE rows.
